e5-base.description: tunnel mode, no TFC padding (strongSwan default tfc_padding=0)

e5-tfc.description: tunnel mode, every ESP packet padded to the path MTU (RFC 4303 sec 2.7)

e5-iptfs.description: AGGFRAG / IP-TFS mode (RFC 9347); charon.iptfs.packet_size set in strongswan.conf

e5-mux.description: tunnel mode, no padding; carries TWO concurrent traffic classes (G-12 multiplexing)
